questions.text: Photograph a map detail for a future visit and add a note about the kind of private time you hope to protect.
questions.intended_outcome: The image creates a consent-led opening to discuss expectations for a future visit.

questions.text: Create a photo of two notes labelled hope and boundary for something you might discuss when you reunite.
questions.intended_outcome: Your partner sees that future curiosity comes with room for both desire and a clear limit.
